description:
Jeht is our UK made full suspension trail bike. The Corner Wizard. Reynolds 853 steel, mixed wheels, 150mm travel.
You know that feeling when you hook up a perfect turn and the whole bike just tracks? The Jeht is built for that. It's a dedicated mixed-wheel (mullet), made in Britain trail bike with 150mm rear travel and a 150-160mm fork, designed to carve through corners and feel the edge knobs bite.
Evolved Cotic Longshot geometry puts you in a "stand tall" position in the middle of the bike, with a planted front end that lets you commit. Reynolds 853 steel front end adds the supple, connected ride feel that decades of Cotic development have tuned.
New Cotic Rocklink takes everything we learned from our proven droplink design and makes room: a fully open front triangle and full dropper insertion, with the same supple, supportive, lively ride.
This isn't a monstertruck that numbs the trail. It's a rally car that dances and jinks, finding grip instead of grabbing brakes.
Why Steel?
Steel on a full-suspension bike isn't nostalgia. The Jeht's front triangle is Reynolds 853, with Cotic exclusive Ovalform top tube and dedicated down tube, a proprietary heat-treated steel strong enough to build light, with the compliance to give and go as the trail pushes back. Out back, a T45 steel seatstay and a 6082-T6 aluminium swingarm bring authority where you need it, and masses of tyre clearance.
What's included

Cotic Jeht Frame
Rockshox Deluxe Ultimate Shock (other options are available, see below)
Front and Rear Thru Axles
All Hose Clips and Guides

Key details

Radical Cotic Longshot geometry, specifically designed for super short 35mm stems, giving incredible steering responsiveness combined with hugely confidence inspiring capability at speed. Proportional C-Sizing brings consistent balance across all sizes.
Dedicated mixed wheelsize "mullet" layout makes cornering a breeze and brings real agility to go with the confident Longshot geometry overall feel.
Reynolds 853, Cotic exclusive Ovalform top tube, HD seat tube builds a precise, durable and strong front end with beautiful ride feel.
44mm standard head tube designed with external bottom cup for taper steerer compatibility and angleset compatibility.
External routing with bespoke, 3D printed cable management makes this one of the easiest bikes to work on.
Rocklink suspension brings traction rich pedal feel, with supportive progression rate.
Open front triangle has mounts for a large bottle and tools inside the triangle.
6082-T6 UK made aluminium swingarm with Syntace X-12 BOOST148 x 12 rear axle and UDH hanger.
Proven 15mm pivot design for main and Rocklink thru axle style pivots.
Cotic exclusive Floating Trunnion shock mount maximises shock life and sensitivity.
Adaptable geometry: Trail spec with 150mm fork, or Enduro at 160mm.
Enduro MAX and SKF bearings for long life and highest performance.
All UK made frames are fitted with Datatag security as standard.
Five sizes, C1 to C5, suiting riders from 5ft 3in to 6ft 5in.
